verdict.rationale: Docusign's CLM product supports conditional rules (e.g. 'Set conditional rules for things like review of non-standard terms') and 'configurable workflows', and its MCP connector can 'Trigger workflow actions through IAM tools', showing some event-driven automation capability. However there is no clear description of a general-purpose rule/trigger engine (e.g. webhooks, if-this-then-that automation) that an AI-native user could define themselves outside CLM's built-in workflow designer. Missing for 10: explicit event-trigger/webhook documentation, examples of user-defined automation rules, and independent verification of the MCP trigger actions working reliably.
